hints.title: Vowel Consonant Balance
hints.text: A valid substring requires vowels == consonants, meaning the prefix difference vowels - consonants must match between start and end.

hints.title: Minimal Divisor Factor
hints.text: Condition v^2 % k == 0 is satisfied if and only if v is a multiple of root, where root is the smallest positive integer such that root^2 % k == 0.

hints.title: Dual-Key Frequency Hashing
hints.text: Store prefix counts with composite key (vowels % root, vowels - consonants) to count matches in a single pass.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def beautifulSubstrings(self, s: str, k: int) -> int:
        root = 1
        while (root * root) % k != 0:
            root += 1
            
        vowels_set = set('aeiou')
        counts = defaultdict(int)
        counts[(0, 0)] = 1
        
        v = 0
        diff = 0
        ans = 0
        for c in s:
            if c in vowels_set:
                v = (v + 1) % root
                diff += 1
            else:
                diff -= 1
            state = (v, diff)
            ans += counts[state]
            counts[state] += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Finding minimal square root followed by linear hash map accumulation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) hash map storing prefix states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Factorize condition v^2 = 0 mod k into linear modular congruence v = 0 mod root.
